title: fix: publish Polli CLI through npm OIDC
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Migrates only `@pollinations/cli` publishing from the expired repository token to npm Trusted Publishing.
- Uses Node 24 and grants the CLI job the required GitHub OIDC permission.
- Retriggers the CLI publisher when this workflow change reaches `main`, allowing unpublished 0.1.12 to ship.
- Requires npm package setting: GitHub Actions publisher `pollinations/pollinations`, workflow `release-publish-npm-packages.yml`, action `npm publish`.

Tests: `actionlint`; `npm run build`; `npm test` (57 passed); `npm pack --dry-run`.

gist.headline: The CLI finds its way home
gist.blurb: Polli’s CLI publishing route has been replanted with npm Trusted Publishing. Version 0.1.12 can now leave the greenhouse and reach npm properly.
gist.summary: Migrated publishing for @pollinations/cli from an expired repository token to npm Trusted Publishing via GitHub OIDC, using Node 24 and retriggering the release workflow so unpublished version 0.1.12 can ship.
gist.impact: Developers can receive @pollinations/cli 0.1.12 from npm again, with releases authenticated through GitHub Actions OIDC rather than a repository token.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a tiny release engineer delivering a boxed @pollinations/cli package from a cozy GitHub Actions-style workshop to an npm package garden. A glowing OIDC key or trusted badge represents the new publishing path, while code-plants and small flowers show that the release pipeline is growing reliably again.
